android_mechanism: String assembled by repeated concatenation; fix uses a builder/join
bug_description: getArtists builds the artist name line with artistStr = artistStr + artist.name + ', ' inside a loop and then strips the trailing separator. It runs in SongCard.aboutToAppear for every visible song row (lists, search results, playlists), allocating an intermediate string per artist per row on the render path.
fix_summary: Names are collected into an array and joined once.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.measured_as: perf_hw-instructions over the song-list render workload (Pura 70 Ultra)
evidence.note: 4.12M vs 2.85M median hw-instructions (1.44x; one run overlaps the fixed range); mechanism counter 8 vs 0 string-concat allocations per row (measurements-staging).

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time in SongCard aboutToAppear per row appearance from JS sampling stacks (getArtists frames), aggregated over the scroll.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows repeated string-concat allocations in getArtists for every row build; fixed shows a single join per row. Aggregate scroll CPU lower in fixed; effect scales with rows rendered.

reproduction: git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_songcard_artists_concat/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_songcard_artists_concat/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
